datasets.source: 1000 Genomes HG00096 30x WGS (NYGC, GRCh38), downsampled to 5M read pairs.
datasets.title: Whole genome (HG00096)

datasets.source: 1000 Genomes HG00100 phase-3 Illumina exome, downsampled to 5M read pairs.
datasets.title: Whole exome (HG00100)

datasets.notes: Deep target coverage produces many split alignments, so this dataset leans on supplementary-alignment handling more than the others.
datasets.source: Agilent SureSelect QXT hereditary-cancer panel, SRR15497869 (PRJNA755485), downsampled to 5M read pairs.
datasets.title: Targeted panel (Agilent SureSelect QXT)

datasets.notes: Aligned with `-5SP` on both bwa-mem3 and bwa-mem2, the canonical Hi-C settings (no mate rescue, no pairing, smallest-coordinate split as primary).
datasets.source: HG002 Hi-C, 1M read pairs (2x151 bp) from Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19703025 (CC BY 4.0).
datasets.title: Hi-C (HG002)

datasets.source: About 1M single-end Roche SBX reads, 50-974 bp (median ~224 bp), HG002, from the Roche Axelios GIAB demonstration data (CC BY-NC 4.0).
datasets.title: Roche SBX (HG002, single-end)

datasets.notes: Compared against bwameth, not bwa-mem2, and run only on m7i (the methylation index needs a 64 GB host).
datasets.source: Twist EM-seq library, downsampled to 5M read pairs, with the 7 bp inline UMI and spacer trimmed from the 5' end of both reads, aligned with `--meth`.
datasets.title: Methylation (Twist EM-seq)

datasets.notes: Measured at one rep per instance type by design; timings are indicative only.
datasets.source: The wgs-5M reads aligned with the reference's `.alt` file present.
datasets.title: Whole genome, ALT-aware (HG00096)
